concerns.text: Tasks T063 (Rule Space Mining), T064 (Scaling Law), T066 (Stupidity Metric), and T067 (Fixed-Point Convergence) have no corresponding FR or SC in spec.md. These tasks implement unrequested scope creep, leaving the implementer with work that cannot be validated against the spec.

Task T061 (Overfitting Detection) introduces a 'held-out validation set' and a '5% gap' threshold. The spec (FR-005, US-1) defines evaluation only on GSM8K, ARC-Challenge, and BoolQ as test benchmarks. There is no requirement to split these into train/val/test or to implement overfitting detection logic, making this task unanchored.

Task T004 implements a RAM warning at 6.8GB. While SC-005 sets a 7GB target, the spec does not mandate a specific internal warning threshold or a dedicated `utils/memory.py` module for this purpose. The task assumes a specific implementation detail not present in the FR/SC, risking a mismatch with the system-level monitoring requirement.

Task T090 is listed in the 'Removed Scope Note' as deleted, yet the ID 'T090' appears in the 'Tasks an independent verifier REJECTED' list and is referenced as a dependency in T017a/T017b (via the 'test_attempt_tracker.py' comment). This creates a broken dependency chain referencing a non-existent task ID.

Task T005a requires failing fast with `FileNotFoundError` for missing local data files. The spec (FR-011, Edge Cases) only mandates exponential backoff for network/API rate limits. There is no explicit requirement to fail immediately on missing local files versus treating them as configuration errors, leaving this behavior unanchored.
